newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: REPORT HITS DUTCH TEMP AGENCIES.
newsitem.headline: REPORT HITS DUTCH TEMP AGENCIES.

text.p: Shares of temporary employment agencies Randstad and Content fell on a generally firmer Dutch bourse on Tuesday after a newspaper reported that a trade union was seeking changes in the way they paid temporary workers.

The report in Het Financieele Dagblad said the FNV Services Union was pressing the agencies to pay workers a gross fee, rather than a net fee, adding that such a move could reduce their margins by 1.5 to 2.0 percent.
Het Financieele Dagblad said the union was threatening to take Randstad to court if the matter could not be settled amicably. Randstad shares were off 4.00 guilders at 128.00.
Content shares were off one guilder at 67.50 and dealers attributed the slide in both shares to the newspaper report.

Het Financieele Dagblad said neither Randstad nor the FNV Services Union were willing to comment on the report pending a December 9 deadline which the union has set for the agency to respond to its demands.
